Liam —

Thanks for the fast reply and for confirming attendees. I’ll bring three cost scenarios to the QBR:
A) 12-month renewal (status quo) + immediate burst block top-up
B) 24-month renewal with staged step-up in Q3 2026 (your primary request) — shows ~12% unit discount plus reduced per-token overage
C) 36-month commit (deeper discount ~18%) with accelerated capacity windows and longer notice windows for scale-downs.

Quick answers inline:
1) Ramp timing/fees: We can support an earlier capacity ramp — we price accelerated ramps as a one-time provisioning uplift (typically 5–10% of the uplifted monthly commit depending on lead time). If you'd like to make earlier increases part of the MAP we can amortize the provisioning uplift across the contract term.
2) Burst credits: Unused burst credits do not normally roll over month-to-month, but for multi-year commits we can propose a partial rollover mechanism in year 2 (we'll put a proposal in the MAP notes).

Prep items I’ll share ahead of the QBR: updated MAP with the three pricing scenarios, a short runbook for burst behavior, and a sizing spreadsheet. Expect those by EOD Tue, Nov 11.
